source: docs/research/research-tools.md (primary sources fetched or searched on 2026-10-03)

conventions.auth_env_origin: Each access entry marks auth_env_origin: 'vendor' when the vendor documents the env var name, 'cstack' when cstack proposes the name because the vendor documents none.
conventions.mcp_tool_patterns: Claude Code names MCP tools mcp__<server>__<tool>. <server> is whatever the user named the server (claude.ai connectors use the display name, e.g. mcp__Figma__*). Match the server segment case-insensitively and also match tool-name fingerprints, never one exact server name.
conventions.confidence: high = read on a vendor-owned page today; medium = vendor page partially confirmed or third-party source only; low = inferred; 'unverified' in a value means no source was found.

tools.name: Cosmos

access.endpoint_or_package: https://www.cosmos.so (human use in a standard browser)
user shares public cluster URLs or downloads/saves images and drops them into the project

mcp.notes: No official Cosmos MCP or public API found. '@polarity-lab/cosmos-mcp' (env COSMOS_TOKEN) is an unrelated personal knowledge-graph server; do not treat it as Cosmos.

returns: images and clusters curated by the user (via export only)
tools.tos_notes: ToS section 8(F) forbids accessing, searching or downloading with any engine, software, tool, agent, robot, crawler or data-mining tool other than Cosmos-provided software or generally available browsers. Agent-driven browsing of Cosmos is therefore not allowed; a human browsing and exporting is.
tools.fallback: Ask the user to paste public cluster URLs or export saved images into the project; route open taste search to Are.na (API) or Taste Labs (MCP) and say Cosmos was not queried.

tools.name: Refero

access.endpoint_or_package: https://api.refero.design/mcp (HTTP)
access.plan: paid plan required: Pro, Team or Lifetime; up to 8,000 MCP tool calls per licensed user per month, no rollover

tools.auth_notes: OAuth preferred; Bearer token (Authorization: Bearer <token>) also documented.
tools.tos_notes: Call limits exist 'to protect the service from automated abuse'; higher limits via a business program. Full ToS not reviewed.
tools.fallback: Use Mobbin MCP if present; otherwise browse public product pages of the named competitors within their ToS, or ask the user for screenshots.

tools.name: Mobbin

access.endpoint_or_package: https://api.mobbin.com/mcp (streamable HTTP, hosted only)
access.plan: unverified (docs do not state a plan tier)

tools.auth_notes: OAuth sign-in in a browser on first use; 'no API key to configure'.
returns: low-res previews plus high-res image_url (expires after 30 days)
tools.tos_notes: Image URLs expire after 30 days; do not hotlink them in durable artifacts, copy only what the plan's terms allow. Full ToS not reviewed.
tools.fallback: Use Refero MCP if present; otherwise ask the user for screenshots or browse public pages within ToS.

tools.name: Ecomm.Design

access.endpoint_or_package: https://ecomm.design/ (public gallery; e.g. /platform/shopify-stores)

returns: store examples by platform, category and tech (via browsing)
tools.tos_notes: unverified: terms not reviewed. Use light, human-paced browsing of public pages only.
tools.fallback: Browse the public gallery to collect store URLs, then visit the stores themselves; or ask the user for a list of reference stores.

tools.name: Baymard Institute
roles: PDP, cart, search and checkout usability guidelines

access.endpoint_or_package: https://baymard.com/blog and https://baymard.com/free-ux-research (free articles); Baymard Premium for full guidelines
access.plan: free articles public; full guideline database needs Baymard Premium (personal seat)

access.endpoint_or_package: user with a Premium seat pastes the relevant guideline text or summary into the session

mcp.notes: No public API or MCP found. Baymard ships its own AI products (UX-Ray site audit, an AI search assistant) inside its web app.

returns: usability guidelines and research findings (via human access)
tools.tos_notes: Terms explicitly prohibit 'any automated extracting, processing, scraping, or reverse-engineering methods'. Premium content may not be redistributed, paraphrased or shared outside the subscribing organization, and accounts are strictly personal. Never automate Baymard; never commit Premium text to a public repo.
tools.fallback: Cite only free public Baymard articles the user or a human opened, or general heuristics labelled as such; ask a Premium user to check specific guidelines and keep their notes private.

tools.name: Particl
roles: which brands, products and promotions work

access.endpoint_or_package: https://mcp.particl.com/mcp
access.plan: API key from the 'Claude & ChatGPT' page of the dashboard; most tools consume export credits included with paid plans

tools.auth_notes: API key; header name not stated on the pages read (see https://www.particl.com/docs/mcp/authentication).
tools.tos_notes: Credit-metered; full ToS not reviewed.
tools.fallback: Public signals only: brand sites, public promo pages, Meta Ad Library; label all sales numbers as unavailable rather than estimating.

tools.name: BuiltWith
roles: technology, theme and app detection for a domain

access.endpoint_or_package: https://api.builtwith.com/mcp (hosted) or self-hosted from github.com/builtwith/builtwith-mcp (stdio or http://127.0.0.1:8787/mcp)
access.plan: BuiltWith API key (paid API credits); exact plan gating unverified

access.endpoint_or_package: https://api.builtwith.com (key via ?KEY= or 'Authorization: API <key>')
access.plan: credit-based API; the separate MCP-registry endpoint is free and limited to 1 req/s

tools.notes: api.builtwith.com/mcp-api documents an endpoint that indexes remote MCP servers across the web; that is different from technology lookup. The vendor page and the GitHub listing disagree on the hosted auth header (Authorization: API vs Bearer); probe both.
tools.tos_notes: Credit-metered; full ToS not reviewed.
tools.fallback: Store Leads if present; otherwise inspect the public page source within ToS (e.g. Shopify theme name in page markup) and label findings as heuristic.

tools.name: Store Leads

access.endpoint_or_package: https://storeleads.app/json/api/v1/all/ (Authorization: Bearer <key>)
access.plan: paid account required; Pro/Elite 5 req/s, Enterprise 20 req/s

access.endpoint_or_package: unverified: the API page lists an 'MCP Server' but no URL was captured

tools.tos_notes: Paid API; full ToS not reviewed.
tools.fallback: BuiltWith if present; otherwise public page-source inspection labelled heuristic.

access.source: unverified (no API or MCP found in search 2026-10-03)

tools.name: Figma
roles: the user's own components, variables/tokens, files, screenshots, Code Connect

access.endpoint_or_package: Remote server https://mcp.figma.com/mcp (recommended); desktop server via the Figma desktop app (local URL commonly http://127.0.0.1:3845/mcp, unverified this pass)
access.plan: Dev or Full seat on Professional (200/day, 10/min), Organization (200/day, 15/min), Enterprise (600/day, 20/min); View/Collab seats 6/month (Starter 20/month)

access.endpoint_or_package: Figma REST API https://api.figma.com (X-Figma-Token header)
access.source: unverified this pass (general Figma developer docs)

tools.auth_notes: OAuth; only clients listed in the Figma MCP Catalog can connect. Enterprise-managed auth for Claude via Okta XAA.
returns: design context (code reference) for a node
tools.tos_notes: Rate limits per seat; whoami, create_new_file and add_code_connect_map are exempt.
tools.fallback: Ask the user to export tokens (JSON) or share frames as PNG; never infer tokens from screenshots without labelling them as estimates.

tools.name: Shopify (Dev MCP, UCP/Storefront MCP)
roles: the user's own catalog, variants, cart and policies

access.endpoint_or_package: UCP MCP at https://{shop}/api/ucp/mcp (Catalog, Cart, Checkout MCP; requests must include an agent profile)
access.plan: public storefront endpoint of any Shopify store

access.endpoint_or_package: Storefront MCP https://{shop}/api/mcp: catalog and cart tools (search_catalog, get_product_details, get_cart, update_cart) deprecated in favour of UCP; search_shop_policies_and_faqs remains
npx -y @shopify/dev-mcp@latest (local, no auth; docs and API schemas only, no store data)
shopify (Shopify CLI) for authenticated store-management tasks via the AI Toolkit plugin/skills

standards.name: Universal Commerce Protocol (UCP)
standards.notes: Open standard from Google and Shopify for agent commerce.

standards.name: WebMCP
standards.notes: Browser-native tool exposure for agents; Chrome early preview. Spec status and API surface unverified this pass.

detect.probe: POST https://{shop}/api/ucp/mcp tools/list (public; needs agent profile)

returns: Shopify API docs and GraphQL schemas (Dev MCP)
tools.tos_notes: Storefront/UCP endpoints are public by design; respect store rate limits and the agent-profile requirement.
tools.fallback: Ask for the store domain and probe the public UCP endpoint; otherwise ask for a product CSV export from the Shopify admin.
